opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts.
opportunities.summary: Open to applications all year round with no deadline. Provides funding for operating/core costs, capital projects, or specific activity projects for eligible charities.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities under Charity Commission guidance; must have annual income over £1 million or project/capital costs over £1 million; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts.
opportunities.summary: Expressions of interest can be submitted all year round with no deadline. Funding for capital or project costs (minimum £1 million total) or core costs for larger charities.
